name: Exhaustion
summary: Each level: D20 Tests -2 and Speed -5 ft. Level 6 is death.
text: Exhaustion is cumulative: each time you get it you gain a level. Every D20 Test you make is reduced by 2 times your Exhaustion level, and your Speed is reduced by 5 feet times your level. You die at level 6. A Long Rest removes one level; at level 0 the condition ends.
